Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-konchu/

A tour where you forage for wild mountain vegetables traditionally eaten locally in Hanno's satoyama (foothill forest), then use them to make and eat pizza and tempura.

【Fee】Adults: ¥4,500 | Students: ¥3,000 | Preschool: ¥2,000 (includes guide, insurance, materials, food)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field Study Hall) staff

【What to bring】Drinks, light snacks, change of clothes, hat, clothes you don't mind getting dirty, comfortable broken-in shoes (boots recommended)

【More info】Mori no Field Gakusha: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
location: 集合 飯能市中央公園トイレ前（国際興業バス「ＯＨ!!!・天覧山下」下車徒歩1分）
